passage: Ms. Rahman's chemistry students spent two weeks testing how temperature affects reaction speed. When the students finished the experiment, ______ wrote a report describing the results.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The pronoun refers to "the students" (plural) and is the subject of "wrote."
"It" and "she" are singular; "them" is an object pronoun.
key: Pronouns must match their antecedent in number and fit their role in the sentence.
